hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that gates swaps until a scheduled activation time and collects trading fees in WETH via swap deltas. Fees follow a time-decaying anti-snipe schedule or a market-cap-decaying curve, split between protocol, creator, and partner, with the creator's share routed into buyback-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, and WETH dividends.
